title: Divine Strike: Thunder (Melee)
html:
This article is about the melee version. For the ranged version, see Divine Strike: Thunder (Ranged). For general information about the feature, see Divine Strike.
Divine Strike: Thunder (Melee) is a Tempest Domain cleric weapon action and reaction that deals extra thunder damage upon a melee weapon strike.

Description

Once per turn deal 1d8⁠⁠Thunder in addition to your weapon's damage when you make a melee attack.

Properties

Cost
 Action
Damage: 1~8
Normal weapon damage
+ 1d8⁠Thunder
Details
 Melee Weapon Attack Roll
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn

Technical details

UID
Target_DivineStrike_Melee_Tempest
Spell flags
IsHarmful, IsMelee

How to learn

This spell is a variation of:
Divine Strike: Thunder

Notes

  • This action can be triggered as a post-strike reaction (without spending a  Reaction), similar to  Divine Smite.
  • Refer to Divine Strike for details about this family of weapon actions.

Bugs

  • This attack is not correctly marked with a thunder DamageType flag, which means it does not trigger certain effects which check for thunder damage, most notably  Destructive Wrath.
